456:t_003:26.en:
$$カイエン$$
「It's $$ミコノ$$'s wish. We'll stay here and watch over her fight.」

456:t_003:27.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「OK, $$カイエン$$! So that means no $$エレメント$$ Change!」

456:t_003:28.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Let's go, $$ミコノ$$...! We'll break through the enemy on our own and head for $$ミカゲ$$!」

456:t_003:29.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Got it, $$アマタ$$! Lend me your courage and strength!」

456:t_003:30.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We're always together! And I'll definitely protect you!」

456:t_003:31.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This heat... I might not survive being in here with you two.」

456:t_003:32.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So you come... the source of it all.」

456:t_003:33.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$...! Today is the day I finally... to you...!」

456:t_004:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Is that all you have, Wingless?」

456:t_005:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Tch...! Between $$バルビエル$$ and this guy, both of them live such pointless lives!」

456:t_005:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What do you know...! About my despair...! My hatred...!」

456:t_006:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Now it's heating up! This is what I came for!」

456:t_007:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Tch...! Between $$バルビエル$$ and this guy, both of them live such pointless lives!」

456:t_007:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What do you know...! About my despair...! My hatred...!」

456:t_008:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So you took my bait, winged dog. Then I will take the one you love and vent even a ten-thousandth of my hatred.」

456:t_008:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do you have the right to say that to me? If not for you, I would have stayed with 《$$アポロニアス#keyword$$》 to the end and lived forever in love.」

456:t_008:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Reincarnation of $$セリアン$$! Offer your body to me!」

456:t_008:4.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This is bad, $$アマタ$$! $$ミカゲ$$ is coming straight for $$ミコノ$$!」

456:t_008:8.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I won't run away anymore... Not from you, and not from my own weakness.」

456:t_008:9.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「What has stayed in my heart for 24,000 years... to you...」

456:t_008:10.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence! I don't know what you intend to do, but do you think I'll let you have your way!」

456:t_008:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Die! Hateful Wingless who took my beloved $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ from me!」

456:t_010:0.en:
???
「Love and hatred are two sides of the same coin...」

456:t_010:2.en:
$$不動$$
「The deeper the hatred, the deeper the love behind it grows...」

456:t_010:3.en:
$$不動$$
「That gave a single ray of light to me, who was trapped in the labyrinth of dimensions.」

456:t_010:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「No matter how much he comes and goes as he pleases, showing up in a place like this...!」

456:t_010:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「That guy... his name is $$不動$$...?」

456:t_010:7.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah. Just like the $$不動ＧＥＮ#pilot$$ we know, he's a sudden, wildly unpredictable character.」

456:t_010:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「When I picked up the Wings of the Sun from the gap between dimensions, I should have cast you into deep, dark darkness, and yet you appear again...!」

456:t_010:11.en:
$$不動$$
「This is my thanks for saving me. I will grant the wish of you... no, of those connected to you.」

456:t_010:13.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! I won't let you lay a hand on $$ミコノ$$!!」

456:t_010:14.en:
$$不動$$
「Now, here, souls cross dimensions and meet again...」

456:t_011:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「This is... the $$オリジン・ロー$$!」

456:t_011:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What on earth is going to happen!?」

456:t_011:2.en:
$$不動$$
「For a short while, all of you will cross dimensions and touch their feelings.」

456:t_013:1.en:
$$シリウス$$
「This pleasure piercing my whole body...!」

456:t_013:2.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Oh, stop! It feels good, 12,000 years' worth!!」

456:t_013:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Impossible! The Mechanical Angel should have fallen completely into darkness!」

456:t_013:4.en:
$$不動$$
「The sun rises again. That is all there is to it.」

456:t_013:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I won't accept it...! I refuse to accept this!!」

456:t_016:0.en:
$$桂$$
「There it is, the original wild one, $$アクエリオン$$!」

456:t_016:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$アポロ$$! So $$アポロ$$ is the one riding that thing!」

456:t_016:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Yeah! $$シリウス$$ and $$シルヴィア$$ are here too!」

456:t_016:3.en:
$$シリウス$$
「There are some faces I haven't seen in a long time.」

456:t_016:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$シリウス$$! $$シルヴィア$$, too!」

456:t_016:6.en:
$$アンディ$$
「No way! So that's the 《$$ディーバ$$》 $$エレメント$$ that fought the $$堕天翅$$ in the $$神話型アクエリオン$$!」

456:t_016:8.en:
$$不動$$
「Accept what is in front of you. It is all fact.」

456:t_016:9.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Two Mechanical Angels! This is amazing!」

456:t_016:10.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I have to get a taste of them!」

456:t_016:12.en:
$$クレア$$
「$$エレメント$$ Change! $$ジン・ムソウ$$, to $$ゲパルト$$!」
